meta.note: final pass: fixed and audited under one brief, see CHECKPOINT.md

scientific_integrity.detail: Fresh PICRUSt2, NSTI, and compositional-analysis outputs are retained under this audit; predicted potential is explicitly separated from measured function.

practice_boundaries.detail: The Skill makes no individual diagnostic or treatment claim.

methodological_ground.detail: It requires NSTI reporting, warns against activity and circularity claims, and requires cross-tool CoDA consensus with normalized IDs.

code_usability.detail: PICRUSt2 2.6.3 completed the documented command on a real 770-ASV input; the shipped NSTI reporter also ran verbatim on its fresh output.

functional_suitability.note: The central pipeline, mandatory NSTI QC, misuse boundaries, and appropriate handoffs are complete and current.

reliability.note: Concrete format, reference-coverage, hard-alignment, and sparse-feature recovery guidance is strong; no bundled automated fixture harness guards future regressions.

performance_context.note: The BIOM-comment trap warning prevents costly discarded computation and the commands expose process count.

agent_usability.note: The decision tree, explicit output files, quality report, and common-error table prevent common agent mistakes.

human_usability.note: Clear scope and remediation are provided; the long technical reference requires careful reading.

security.note: No secrets, shell interpolation of user strings, or unsafe execution pattern is shipped.

maintainability.note: NSTI logic is now a maintained script with CLI arguments; the example retains a deliberate inline whole-workflow copy.

agent_specific.note: Trigger scope is precise, handoffs are explicit, and it has strong escape hatches for out-of-reference communities and measured-function needs.

key_strengths: The central documented PICRUSt2 2.6.3 command was freshly run end to end on real ASVs, producing parsed KO, EC, MetaCyc, and NSTI outputs.
The shipped NSTI reporter completed verbatim on the fresh 2.6.3 combined filename and quantified both ASV and read loss.
The P2 LinDA prevalence instruction was freshly verified on the new pathway table alongside the documented cross-tool feature-name normalization.
Boundary and reasoning checks preserve scientifically correct scope: predicted potential is neither measured function nor activity, and functional DA is not independent taxonomy corroboration.

recommendations.title: State expected full-run time more prominently
recommendations.problem: Fresh real runs required roughly 35 minutes of reference placement/interpolation before producing outputs, while the Skill only says expensive work can take minutes.
recommendations.root_cause: The performance caveat describes the BIOM-format waste but does not give a realistic planning expectation for a standard real-ASV run.
recommendations.fix: Add a brief runtime-planning note beside the main command, stating that a real several-hundred-ASV run can take tens of minutes and should be budgeted before launch.
